toolName.title: Tool Name
toolName.description: Name of the MCP tool to execute (e.g. zero-leak-mcp, 3d-meshweaver-mcp, or 'list')

payload.title: JSON Payload
payload.description: JSON object with query parameters (optional when toolName is list)

paymentSignature.title: AgentCash / Web3 Payment Signature (Optional)
paymentSignature.description: EIP-3009 Signature or AgentCash token to pass the 402 Paywall
